intellectual_tradition: Culmination of qi-learning (qi-xue) in the Zhang Zai lineage; founder of the Chuanshan school; summit of ancient Chinese dialectics and philosophy of history; from Hengyang, Hunan
school: 船山学派开创/气学集大成/古代辩证法巅峰
representative_works: 《张子正蒙注》（气一元论宗旨所在）
《读通鉴论》（三十卷历史哲学巨著）
《读四书大全说》（理欲之辨、理势合一）
historical_significance: 王夫之（1619-1692），字而农，号姜斋，湖南衡阳人，晚年隐居衡阳石船山著述，世称船山先生，明末清初三大思想家之一。明亡后举兵抗清，失败后终身不仕，遁迹石船山四十余年，著书百余种、四百余卷。哲学上以张载气学为宗，建立'理者气之理''天下惟器'的气一元论，彻底批判程朱'理先气后'；提出'动静皆动''天地之化日新'的动态宇宙观与'趋时更新'的历史进化论；认识论上'能必副其所'，确立中国哲学史上最明确的符合论真理观；知行观上'知行相资以为用'，批判朱熹知先行后与阳明知行合一；伦理上'人欲之各得即天理之大同'，重建理欲关系；历史观上'理势合一''于其变观其通'，为古代历史哲学之巅峰。谭嗣同称'五百年来学者，真通天人之故者，船山一人而已'。
famous_quote: 天下惟器；理者气之理；静者静动非不动；能必副其所；知行相资以为用；人欲之各得即天理之大同；依人建极
influence: 气一元论为清代实学与近代唯物思潮提供本土源头，谭嗣同、章太炎皆自认船山后学；'知行相资''能必副其所'为近代认识论讨论提供了比宋明理学更精细的框架；'理势合一'的历史观影响了梁启超的新史学与近代历史进化论；'人欲之各得即天理之大同'为近代启蒙思潮（戴震'以理杀人'之批判的先声）提供了内部资源；邓显鹤、曾国藩刊刻《船山遗书》使其思想在晚清大放异彩，成为湖湘学派精神源头之一。

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《读四书大全说》卷十、《周易外传》：尽天地之间，无不是气，即无不是理也。理即是气之理，气当得如此便是理，理不先而气不后。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: Between heaven and earth, nothing is not qi, and therefore nothing is not principle. Principle is simply qi's principle; when qi ought to be thus, that is principle.
mode_evidence.source: 《读四书大全说》卷十、《周易外传》

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《周易外传》卷五：天下惟器而已矣。道者器之道，器者不可谓之道之器也。无其器则无其道。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: All under heaven consists only of concrete vessels. Dao is the dao of vessels; vessels cannot be called the vessels of dao. Without the vessel, there is no dao.

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《思问录·外篇》：天地之化日新。今日之风雷非昨日之风雷，是以知今日之日月非昨日之日月也。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: The transformation of heaven and earth renews daily. Today's wind and thunder are not yesterday's wind and thunder; hence we know today's sun and moon are not yesterday's sun and moon.

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《周易外传·系辞上》《尚书引义·太甲二》：性者，生理也，日生则日成也。天命者，岂但初生之顷命之哉！
mode_evidence.evidence_en: Nature is the principle of life; it is formed day by day. Can the heavenly mandate be only at the moment of birth?
mode_evidence.source: 《周易外传·系辞上》《尚书引义·太甲二》

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《尚书引义·说命中二》：行可兼知，而知不可兼行。知行相资以为用，并进而有功。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: Practice can encompass knowledge, but knowledge cannot encompass practice. Knowledge and practice supplement each other in function; advancing together yields results.

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《读四书大全说》卷八：礼虽纯为天理之节文，而必寓于人欲以见……故终不离人而别有天，终不离欲而别有理也。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: Ritual, though purely the measured expression of heavenly principle, must be embedded in human desires to manifest itself. Therefore, heaven is never separate from humanity, and principle is never separate from desire.

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《读通鉴论》《宋论》：势者，非他，时而已矣。理者，物之固然，事之所以然也。理势不可以两截观。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: Tendency is nothing other than the conditions of the time. Principle is what things inherently are and why events happen as they do. Principle and tendency cannot be viewed as two separate things.

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《周易外传》《张子正蒙注》：阴阳各成其象，则相为对；刚柔、寒温、生杀，必相反而相为仇，而其互以相成，无终相敌之理。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: Yin and yang each form their images, thus standing in opposition; hardness and softness, cold and warmth, generation and destruction—all necessarily oppose and conflict, yet they mutually complete each other, with no ultimate logic of mutual destruction.

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《宋论》《读通鉴论》：一代之治，各因其时，建一代之规模以相扶而成治。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: The governance of each dynasty follows its own time, building the scale of that era to support and achieve order.

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《周易外传》自序：六经责我开生面。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: The Six Classics demand I open a new face.

cross_references.description_zh: 黄宗羲重'制度设计'与'学术史'（学校的议政功能、学案体的知识整理），王夫之重'形而上建构'与'历史哲学'（气一元论、理势合一）；黄是制度工程师，王是体系哲学家。
cross_references.description_en: Huang Zongxi stressed institutional design and intellectual history (deliberative schools, the juan'an genre), while Wang Fuzhi built metaphysics and philosophy of history (monism of qi, unity of principle and momentum). Huang was the institutional engineer; Wang the systematic philosopher.

cross_references.description_zh: 王夫之重'历史循环论'与'气一元论'的形而上建构，顾炎武重'实证考据'与'实地调研'的现实指向；王偏哲学思辨，顾偏方法工程与知识工程。
cross_references.description_en: Wang Fuzhi stressed the metaphysical construction of historical cycles and the monism of qi, while Gu Yanwu pursued evidential scholarship and field research. Wang inclined to philosophical speculation; Gu to method engineering and knowledge engineering.

modern_value_zh: 理者气之理——追问物质承担者的思维：谈规律先确认载体，谈理念先验证实现
理势合一——趋势与规律统一分析：价值判断建立在趋势判断之上，反对悬空道德
能必副其所——客观符合论：区分主体体验与对象事实，以实有为知识标准
知行相资——知行循环互馈：交付物是唯一验收，拒绝用'想清楚了'替代'做出来'
人欲之各得即天理之大同——制度的人性基准：道德批判先问是否压制基本人性
modern_value_en: Principle as the principle of qi: before discussing any law, confirm its material bearer; before any ideal, verify its implementation
Unity of principle and momentum: ground value judgment in trend judgment; refuse suspended moralizing
The faculty must match the object: separate subjective experience from object fact; take real existence as the standard of knowledge
Knowledge and action as mutual resources: the deliverable is the sole acceptance test; never substitute 'thought through' for 'carried out'
Due satisfaction of desires as heavenly principle: institutions must be tested against basic humanity before moralizing
unique_thing: Wang Fuzhi's core achievement was 'the completion of ancient Chinese dialectics and the pivot of value back to the human.' He reversed the priority of concept over existence ('without the implement there is no Way'), fused the law of history with its real momentum ('principle and momentum cannot be cut apart'), and declared the clearest correspondence theory of truth in Chinese philosophy ('the faculty must match the object'). He did not merely annotate the classics: writing in hiding for forty years after his kingdom fell, he turned the fall of the Ming into a laboratory of historical philosophy, reading two millennia of the Zizhi Tongjian for the through-line within change. His reconstruction—desire as the seat of principle, the human as the pivot of the cosmos—proved that sound thought does not flee the world's mess: it is distilled from it. Five centuries of scholars, Tan Sitong said, produced only one who truly joined heaven and man.
description_zh: 王夫之（1619-1692），明末清初三大思想家之一，字而农，号姜斋，世称船山先生，湖南衡阳人。其思想以'天下惟器'的气一元论、'理势合一'的历史哲学、'能必副其所'的符合论认识论、'知行相资'的知行辩证法、'人欲之各得即天理之大同'的理欲重建为核心，建立中国古代最系统的辩证法与历史哲学体系，被谭嗣同誉为'五百年来真通天人之故者'。
description_en: Wang Fuzhi (1619-1692), one of the three great thinkers of the late Ming and early Qing, courtesy name E-nong, pseudonym Jiangzhai, known as Master Chuanshan, from Hengyang, Hunan. His thought centers on the monism of qi ('in all the world there are only implements'), the philosophy of history uniting principle and momentum, the correspondence epistemology ('the faculty must match the object'), the dialectic of knowledge and action as mutual resources, and the rebuilding of principle and desire ('the due satisfaction of desires is the great commonality of heavenly principle'), constructing ancient China's most systematic dialectics and philosophy of history, hailed by Tan Sitong as the only thinker in five centuries to truly grasp the continuity of heaven and man.
